title: Pithyx update file manifest v1
description: `manifest.json` at the root of a `.pithyxupdate` (D338): what the file installs and the SHA-256 of every other file in it. `manifest.json.sig` next to it signs its exact bytes (the format of `index-signature.v1.schema.json`); the box checks the signature before it parses the manifest and the hashes before it unpacks anything. Readers ignore fields they do not know.

version.description: The Pithyx version the file installs (SemVer).

channel.description: `stable` for releases on `master`, `beta` for `dev`. A box on the stable channel accepts only stable files.

minimumVersion.description: The oldest installed version the file can update: every package it leaves out is at least as new on a box of that version.

commit.description: The commit of pithyx/pithyx the packages were built from.

kernel.description: The kernel and ZFS module pair of pithyx-kernel.

release.description: The kernel release, as `uname -r` shows it.

zfs.description: The Debian version of zfsutils-linux and the module.

files.description: Every file of the update besides `manifest.json` and its signature, in path order. A file the list does not name is refused.

packages.description: The Debian packages in `debs/`, for the history and the dialog. `pithyx` and `pithyx-kernel` are always there.

changelog.description: The section of CHANGELOG.md for this version, as Markdown.
